title: Mumbai Metro future map
h1: Mumbai Metro · open, building and planned
sub: Every open, under-construction, approved and proposed metro line in Mumbai. Data as of Oct 2026.
notes:
Sources: Wikipedia station tables checked against 2025–26 news; open lines traced from OpenStreetMap. Corridors without published stations are drawn between their named endpoints. Years without an official target are estimates by stage.
Excluded: Mumbai Suburban Railway (Western/Central/Harbour/Trans-Harbour) and the BKC pod taxi, by request.
Segment station lists include both endpoints, so adjacent segments share a station; n_stations = len(stations) except where list is empty (then official count).
Operational as of 2026-10 (Wikipedia network table): L1, 2A, 2B (Mandale–Chembur, 6 stns), 3, 7, 9 (Dahisar E–Kashigaon) = 79 stations / 91.48 km. Monorail is built but suspended since 2025-09-20.
Opening dates: Line 3 inaugurated 5 Oct 2024/public 7 Oct; phases 9/10 May 2025 and 8/9 Oct 2025. Line 2B/9 inaugurated 7 Apr 2026, public 8 Apr. Months are unaffected.
Line 4/4A: no source confirms opening by mid-Oct 2026 (latest Sep 2026: trials, CMRS rolling-stock clearance 28 Aug). Re-check before publishing; could open around Diwali/Nov 2026.
Line 2B naming conflict: news names Phase-1 stations 'Diamond Garden, Shivaji Chowk, BSNL Metro, Mankhurd, Mandale'; Wikipedia uses 'Deshbhakt N.G. Acharya Udyan-Diamond Garden, Chembur', 'Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Chowk (Chembur)', 'Deonar' (= BSNL Metro, inferred), 'Maharashtranagar Mandale'. First 2B station after Andheri (W) was ESIC Nagar in tender docs; Wikipedia now 'Hare Ram Hare Krishna Mandir - Juhu' (likely renamed, unverified). Old Airport/National College/MMRDA/Kurla Terminus stations dropped.
Line 2B station count: planned 20–22 vs 19 new stations in Wikipedia list; 2B length 23.643 km.
Line 9: Amar Palace/Jhankar Company were earlier names (inferred: now Miragaon/Kashigaon). Phase 2 target conflicts: Dec 2026 (station table, CM) vs Dec 2027 (Wikipedia summary).
